_comment: Progress tracker for the Qaloon Quran dataset. One entry per printed page once its batch starts. Pages not yet started are absent from `pages`. Status values: transcribed_unverified (AI draft, human check pending) -> verified (human checked word-by-word).

source.batch_1_pdf: Range_1_-_1_10.pdf (10 pages, supplied by the user, cut from the full mushaf)
source.pdf_page_to_printed_page: printed = pdf_page + 1 (PDF page 1 = printed page 2); printed page 1 not in the PDF, deferred
